name: USDKG
oneLiner: USDKG is Gold Dollar's gold-backed dollar token; the issuer has announced termination and offers holders email-based exchange for fiat or USDT.

notices.title: Issuer operations terminating
notices.message: The issuer's termination notice cites Kyrgyz Cabinet Order 639-t dated August 20, 2026 and says USDKG operations, including blockchain activities, are ceasing. Holders may email hello@usdkg.com to request exchange for fiat or USDT; no payout duration is published.

collateral: Physical gold bars (~376 kg, 30 bars) sourced from the Kyrgyz Ministry of Finance via state gold enterprise Kyrgyzaltyn (LBMA Good Delivery listed); stored in sealed boxes at an unnamed bank under custody of LLC Virelint Group
pegMechanism: Historically minted and redeemed against USD, Kyrgyzstani som, physical gold or approved cryptocurrencies through Gold Dollar. The current termination notice directs holders to email the issuer for fiat or USDT exchange without a published payout duration.

proofOfReserves.provider: Kreston Digital Assets Ltd (ISRS 4400 agreed-upon-procedures provider; the transparency portal currently indexes one reserve report, for 28 November 2025; the January 2025 document is a Consensys smart-contract audit).

latestReport.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (ISRS 4400 Revised report of factual findings, no opinion; disclosed scope gap: vault access log withheld under bank safety rules; the site's live gold figure is unbacked by any newer artefact)

sources.label: Kreston Digital Assets USDKG agreed-upon-procedures report - November 2025

jurisdiction.regulator: Financial Market Regulatory and Supervisory Service under the Ministry of Economy and Commerce of the Kyrgyz Republic
